intro.what: Present Simple odatiy va doimiy ish-harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi. Present Continuous esa ayni damda, hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish-harakatlarni bildiradi.
when: Present Simple: doimiy odatlar va qaytariladigan ishlar uchun (He usually wears jeans.)
Present Simple: 100% to'g'ri faktlar uchun (She works in a bank.)
Present Continuous: ayni damda, hozir bo'layotgan ishlar uchun (Today he's wearing a suit.)
Present Continuous: vaqtinchalik holatlar uchun (She's working at home today.)

structures.label: (-) Present Simple
structures.example_en: She doesn't work in a bank today.

structures.label: (+) Present Continuous
structures.example_en: He is wearing a suit now.

structures.label: (-) Present Continuous
structures.example_en: I am not wearing jeans today.

structures.label: (?) Present Continuous
structures.example_en: Are you working at home today?

rules.title: Present Simple vaqt so'zlari
rules.text: Odatdagi ishlarni ko'rsatish uchun usually, every day so'zlari ishlatiladi.

rules.title: Present Continuous vaqt so'zlari
rules.text: Hozirgi vaqtinchalik ishlarni ko'rsatish uchun now, today, at the moment so'zlari keladi.

examples.en: She is working at home today.
Look! He is wearing a suit.

mistakes.wrong: He is wear a suit today.
mistakes.right: He is wearing a suit today.
mistakes.why: Present Continuous zamonida fe'lga -ing qo'shimchasi qo'shilishi shart.
Odatdagi ishlar uchun Present Simple ishlatiladi va he/she/it da fe'lga -s qo'shiladi.

mistakes.right: I am working at home now.
mistakes.why: Present Continuous uchun tobe fe'li (am/is/are) tushib qolmasligi kerak.

test.q: He usually ______ jeans at home. [wear]
test.explain: He olmoshi bilan Present Simple zamonida fe'lga -s qo'shiladi.

test.q: Today he ______ a suit. [wear]
test.explain: Today so'zi va bugungi holat uchun Present Continuous (is wearing) ishlatiladi.

test.q: She ______ in a bank every day. [work]
test.explain: Every day so'zi Present Simple zamonini bildiradi, she uchun -s qo'shiladi.

test.q: She ______ at home today. [work]
test.explain: Today va vaqtinchalik ish uchun Present Continuous (is working) ishlatiladi.

test.q: Look! Aziz ______ a red T-shirt. [wear]
test.explain: Look! buyrug'i Present Continuous zamonini talab qiladi.

test.q: Ali usually ______ a blue shirt. [wear]
test.explain: Usually so'zi odatni bildiradi, shuning uchun Present Simple (wears) ishlatamiz.

test.q: I ______ in Tashkent every year. [live]
test.explain: I olmoshi bilan Present Simple'da fe'l o'zgarmasdan qoladi.

test.q: At the moment, I ______ in a hotel. [live]
test.explain: At the moment so'zi ayni damdagi davomiy ish-harakatni bildiradi.

test.q: They usually ______ coffee in the morning. [drink]
test.explain: They olmoshi bilan Present Simple'da fe'l o'z holicha qoladi.

test.q: Right now, she ______ tea. [drink]
test.explain: Right now iborasi Present Continuous zamonini talab qiladi.

test.q: He ______ jeans today. [not + wear]
test.explain: Today va vaqtinchalik inkor holat uchun Present Continuous (isn't wearing) kerak.

test.q: She usually ______ jeans. [not + wear]
test.explain: Present Simple inkor shaklida she uchun doesn't va asosiy fe'l keladi.

test.q: You ______ a suit now. [not + wear]
test.explain: You olmoshi bilan Present Continuous inkor shakli aren't wearing bo'ladi.

test.q: We usually ______ meat on Sundays. [eat]
test.explain: Usually odatni bildiradi, shuning uchun Present Simple ishlatiladi.

test.q: Today we ______ a nice fish. [eat]
test.explain: Today so'zi bilan bugungi vaqtinchalik ish-harakat uchun Present Continuous ishlatiladi.

test.q: ______ you wear a tie every day? [do]
test.explain: Present Simple so'roq gapida you olmoshi uchun Do yordamchi fe'li ishlatiladi.

test.q: ______ you wearing a tie today? [be]
test.explain: Present Continuous so'roq gapida you oldidan Are fe'li keladi.

test.q: What ______ she wearing today? [be]
test.explain: Present Continuous so'roq gapida she oldidan is fe'li keladi.

test.q: What ______ she usually wear? [do]
test.explain: Present Simple so'roq gapida she uchun does yordamchi fe'li ishlatiladi.

test.q: Look! The dog ______ in the garden. [run]
test.explain: Look! so'zi bilan hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish-harakat uchun Present Continuous ishlatiladi.

test.q: He usually ______ a black coat in winter.
test.explain: Usually so'zi Present Simple zamonini bildiradi va he uchun wears to'g'ri keladi.

test.q: Look! She ______ a beautiful red dress today.
test.explain: Look! so'zi hozirgi davomiy zamon (Present Continuous) ishlatilishini ko'rsatadi.

test.q: My brother works in a bank, but today he ______ at home.
test.explain: Today so'zi va vaqtinchalik holat uchun Present Continuous (is working) ishlatiladi.

test.q: We usually ______ coffee, but now we ______ tea.
test.explain: Odatdagi ishga Present Simple (drink), hozirgi ishga Present Continuous (are drinking) ishlatiladi.

test.q: ______ you wear jeans to school every day?
test.explain: Every day va Present Simple so'roq gapi uchun Do yordamchi fe'li ishlatiladi.

test.q: ______ you wearing a jacket right now?
test.explain: Right now so'zi Present Continuous zamonini bildiradi va you uchun Are ishlatiladi.

test.q: Aziz ______ a blue shirt today. He is wearing a white T-shirt.
test.explain: Bugungi vaqtinchalik inkor holat uchun Present Continuous inkor shakli (isn't wearing) kerak.

test.q: Malika doesn't wear jeans. She always ______ a skirt.
test.explain: Always va Present Simple doimiy ish-harakati uchun she olmoshi bilan wears ishlatiladi.

test.q: Listen! The baby ______ in the bedroom.
test.explain: Listen! buyrug'i ayni damda davom etayotgan ish-harakatni (Present Continuous) bildiradi.

test.q: What ______ you doing at the moment?
test.explain: At the moment va Present Continuous so'roq gapida you oldidan are tobe fe'li ishlatiladi.

en: He usually wears jeans, but today he is wearing a suit.

tr51.uz: U bankda ishlaydi, lekin bugun u uyda ishlayapti.
en: She works in a bank, but today she is working at home.
tr51.rule: Doimiy holat va bugungi vaqtinchalik holat.

tr51.uz: Men har kuni qahva ichaman, lekin hozir choy ichyapman.
en: I usually drink coffee every day, but now I am drinking tea.
I drink coffee every day, but now I am drinking tea.

tr51.uz: Ular odatda mashinada boradi, lekin bugun poezdda ketyapti.

tr51.uz: Siz har kuni ingliz tilini o'rganasizmi? – Yo'q, hozir televizor ko'ryapman.

Do you study English every day? - No, I am watching TV now.

tr51.uz: U har kuni soat 7 da turadi, lekin bugun kechroq turyapti.
en: He usually gets up at 7 o'clock, but today he is getting up later.
He gets up at 7 o'clock every day, but today he is getting up later.

tr51.uz: Sen har kuni nonushta qilasanmi? – Ha, lekin hozir ishlayapman.
en: Do you have breakfast every day? - Yes, but now I am working.
tr51.rule: Odat va hozirgi zamonni birga ishlatish.

tr51.uz: Ular yakshanba kunlari futbol o'ynaydi, lekin hozir dam olyapti.

tr51.uz: Aziz har kuni ko'ylak kiyadi, lekin bugun kurtka kiyib olgan.

tr51.uz: Biz odatda Toshkentda yashaymiz, lekin bu hafta Samarqandda turibmiz.
en: We usually live in Tashkent, but this week we are staying in Samarkand.

tr51.uz: U har kuni kitob o'qiydi, lekin hozir xat yozyapti.
en: He usually reads a book every day, but now he is writing a letter.
He reads a book every day, but now he is writing a letter.

tr51.uz: Sen har kuni choy ichasanmi? – Ha, lekin hozir suv ichyapman.
en: Do you drink tea every day? - Yes, but now I am drinking water.

tr51.uz: Ular har kuni maktabga boradi, lekin bugun uyda dam olyapti.
en: They usually go to school every day, but today they are relaxing at home.

tr51.rule: Har kunlik maktab va bugungi dam olish.

tr51.uz: U odatda shahar markazida ishlaydi, lekin hozir uyda ishlayapti.
en: She usually works in the town centre, but now she is working at home.
tr51.rule: Doimiy ish joyi va ayni paytdagi joy.

tr51.uz: Mushuklar sut ichadi, lekin bu mushuk hozir suv ichyapti.
en: Cats drink milk, but this cat is drinking water now.
tr51.rule: Umumiy fakt va hozirgi aniq harakat.

tr51.uz: U odatda kechasi uxlaydi, lekin bugun tungi smenada ishlayapti.
en: He usually sleeps at night, but today he is working at night.

tr51.uz: Men har kuni ertalab yuguraman, lekin bugun yomg'ir yog'yapti.
en: I usually run every morning, but today it is raining.

tr51.uz: Ular har shanba xarid qiladi, lekin bugun uyda o'tiribdi.
en: They usually go shopping every Saturday, but today they are sitting at home.

tr51.uz: Sen odatda nima yeysan? – Men hozir olma yeyapman.
en: What do you usually eat? - I am eating an apple now.
tr51.rule: Odat haqidagi savol va hozirgi javob.

tr51.uz: Qizlar odatda raqsga tushadi, lekin hozir musiqa tinglayapti.
en: The girls usually dance, but now they are listening to music.

tr51.uz: U har kuni kechki ovqatni pishiradi, lekin bugun restoranda yeyapti.
en: She usually cooks dinner every day, but today she is eating at a restaurant.

tr51.uz: Biz odatda inglizcha gaplashamiz, lekin hozir o'zbekcha gaplashyapmiz.
en: We usually speak English, but now we are speaking Uzbek.

tr51.uz: Ular har yili yozda dengizga boradi, lekin bu yil tog'ga ketyapti.
en: They usually go to the sea in summer, but this year they are going to the mountains.

tr51.uz: Tom odatda ko'zoynak taqadi, lekin hozir taqmagan.
en: Tom usually wears glasses, but now he is not wearing them.

tr51.uz: Siz har kuni musiqa tinglaysizmi? – Yo'q, hozir kitob o'qiyapman.
en: Do you listen to music every day? - No, I am reading a book now.

tr51.uz: Ular odatda ertalab qahva ichadi, lekin hozir choy ichyapti.
en: They usually drink coffee in the morning, but now they are drinking tea.

tr51.uz: Men har kuni soat 8 da ishga boraman, lekin bugun uyda ishlayapman.
en: I usually go to work at 8 o'clock, but today I am working at home.
I go to work at 8 o'clock every day, but today I am working at home.

tr51.uz: Ular odatda parkda sayr qiladi, lekin hozir yomg'ir yog'yapti.
en: They usually walk in the park, but now it is raining.

tr51.uz: Sen har kuni dars tayyorlaysanmi? – Ha, lekin hozir dam olyapman.
en: Do you do your homework every day? - Yes, but now I am relaxing.
tr51.rule: Kundalik vazifa va hozirgi dam olish.

tr51.uz: Ular odatda ingliz tilini o'rganadi, lekin hozir o'yin o'ynayapti.
en: They usually learn English, but now they are playing games.
